failure_rate_comparison.description: Failure rates on the Maros-Meszaros QP benchmark at medium (1e-6) and high (1e-9) requested accuracy, reported in Table III.

failure_rate_medium.description: Residual-certified failure percentage at 1e-6 requested accuracy on the evaluated Maros-Meszaros slice.

failure_rate_high.description: Residual-certified failure percentage at 1e-9 requested accuracy, used to catch methods that only work at looser tolerances.

mean_iterations_medium.description: Mean solver iterations at 1e-6 requested accuracy, assigning the iteration cap to missing or failed problems as a machine-independent convergence cost.

mean_iterations_high.description: Mean solver iterations at 1e-9 requested accuracy, assigning the iteration cap to missing or failed problems as a machine-independent convergence cost.

attempted_count.description: Number of benchmark instances actually attempted, so reduced coverage cannot masquerade as robustness.

degenerate_problems.description: Iteration counts on three degenerate QPs with redundant inequalities, LICQ failure, and multiple solutions, reported in Table IV. The paper marks OSQP's LICQ-failure entry with a dagger note ('declared dual infeasible') rather than a numeric iteration count.

redundant_ineq.description: Iteration count on the redundant-inequality degenerate QP.

licq_failure.description: Iteration count on the degenerate QP that violates LICQ.

multiple_solutions.description: Iteration count on the degenerate QP with non-unique primal solutions.
